description.value:
The troop has dropped below its higher Hit Point threshold and lost a segment, leaving three segments (12 squares). The threshold is the troop's new maximum Hit Points: while this effect is present, healing cannot raise the troop's Hit Points above it.

This effect persists between encounters to track the unit's strength. To restore lost segments and maximum Hit Points, the troop needs downtime to use long-term treatment on casualties or recruit new members — remove this effect when it recovers.
